description: Conjunto de datos: Road Network Flood Risk Dataset – Aconcagua River Basin is a data set deposited in puc.dataverse by its authors Manuel Contreras-Jara, Echaveguren Tomás ((Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile)). This dataset provides the baseline road network information and traffic simulation results for the Aconcagua River Basin, Chile, developed to support flood risk analysis of road infrastructure. Coverage: national (CL); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
